title: The Flammable Ocean Floor
hook: You think the deep ocean floor is solid rock — it is actually flammable ice.
script: You think the deep ocean floor is solid rock — it is actually flammable ice. What happens if climate change thaws these frozen methane deposits under the sea? A block the size of a washing machine expands to fill a two-story home. These deposits hold ten times more carbon than our entire atmosphere. As oceans warm, the solid seabed loses its grip. The ocean floor literally liquefies. Collapsing slopes can sever the subsea cables carrying almost all internet traffic. Our world sits on a thin crust holding back a trapped sea of gas.
